about.title: One Collective. Multiple Cravings.
about.p1: Crossway Collective is a curated portfolio of food brands created to serve every craving, every mood, and every occasion.
about.p2: Built on a passion for quality ingredients, authentic recipes, and consistent customer experiences, each brand under the Collective offers its own unique culinary identity while sharing the same commitment to excellence.
about.p3: Whether you're looking for comforting South Indian meals, flavour-packed Indian favourites, café-style indulgences, global comfort food, or handcrafted desserts, Crossway Collective has something for everyone.

BrandsPage.subtitle: Five distinct food brands, each with its own culinary identity — all sharing the same commitment to quality and taste.

svanna.heading: Best of Indian Flavours
svanna.tagline: A celebration of India's rich culinary heritage.
svanna.description: From aromatic biryanis and flavourful curries to regional favourites and chef-crafted specialties, Svanna brings together the best of Indian cuisine in every order.

pucca.heading: Flavours of South India
pucca.tagline: Authentic South Indian flavours inspired by the rich culinary traditions of Tamil Nadu and Kerala.
pucca.description: Pucca South brings together cherished regional recipes, fresh local ingredients, and time-honoured cooking techniques to create wholesome meals that celebrate the vibrant food culture of South India. From comforting Tamil classics to flavourful Kerala specialties, every dish is prepared to deliver the warmth and authenticity of home.

mirea.heading: Global & Pan-Asian Cuisine
mirea.tagline: Contemporary café favourites inspired by global flavours.
mirea.description: From Asian-inspired dishes and comfort bowls to café classics and handcrafted beverages, Mirea Café offers a modern food experience delivered fresh.

saddle.heading: Global & Indian Food
saddle.description: The Saddle Room brings together global favourites and Indian classics, creating a menu that's perfect for every mood and every meal.

reejo.heading: Premium Desserts
reejo.tagline: Made to celebrate life's sweetest moments.
reejo.description: From indulgent cakes and handcrafted pastries to premium desserts and bakery favourites, Reejo Bakes delivers happiness in every bite.
